woocommerceContentMappingHelp: Choose which attributes feed into each WooCommerce push field, and in what order. Content fields (Description, Short Description) combine every mapped attribute into labeled sections. Product fields (Name, Price, Image, ...) use the first mapped attribute that has a value — map more than one to set up a fallback.
